import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static class Flow {
        static class Edge {
            int to, rev;
            long f, c, p;
            Edge(int to, int rev, long f, long c, long p) {
                this.to = to;
                this.rev = rev;
                this.f = f;
                this.c = c;
                this.p = p;
            }
        }

        static List<Edge>[] adj;
        static int[] sz;
        static long mc;
        static boolean[] vis;
        static int[] par;
        static long[] pot, dist;
        static final long INF = Long.MAX_VALUE / 2;

        @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
        static void init(int n) {
            mc = 0;
            adj = new List[n];
            sz = new int[n];
            vis = new boolean[n];
            par = new int[n];
            pot = new long[n];
            dist = new long[n];
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                adj[i] = new ArrayList<>();
            }
        }

        static void addEdge(int a, int b, long c, long p) {
            mc = Math.max(mc, c);
            adj[a].add(new Edge(b, sz[b]++, 0, c, p));
            adj[b].add(new Edge(a, sz[a]++, 0, 0, -p));
        }

        static void potInit(int n) {
            Arrays.fill(pot, 0);
            for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
                for (int u = 0; u < n; u++) {
                    for (Edge e : adj[u]) {
                        if (e.c > 0) {
                            pot[e.to] = Math.min(pot[e.to], pot[u] + e.p);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        static long mcf(int s, int t, long[] price, int n, boolean sparse) {
            Arrays.fill(vis, false);
            Arrays.fill(dist, INF);
            dist[s] = 0;
            if (sparse) {
                Queue<Integer> dk = new LinkedList<>();
                dk.add(s);
                while (!dk.isEmpty()) {
                    int u = dk.poll();
                    if (vis[u]) continue;
                    for (Edge e : adj[u]) {
                        if (e.f < e.c && dist[e.to] > dist[u] + pot[u] - pot[e.to] + e.p) {
                            dist[e.to] = dist[u] + pot[u] - pot[e.to] + e.p;
                            par[e.to] = e.rev;
                            dk.add(e.to);
                        }
                    }
                }
            } else {
                for (int u = s; u != -1; ) {
                    vis[u] = true;
                    for (Edge e : adj[u]) {
                        if (e.f < e.c && dist[e.to] > dist[u] + pot[u] - pot[e.to] + e.p) {
                            dist[e.to] = dist[u] + pot[u] - pot[e.to] + e.p;
                            par[e.to] = e.rev;
                        }
                    }
                    u = -1;
                    long best = INF;
                    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                        if (!vis[i] && dist[i] < best) {
                            best = dist[i];
                            u = i;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            if (dist[t] >= INF) return 0;
            long df = INF;
            for (int u = t; u != s; ) {
                Edge r = adj[u].get(par[u]);
                df = Math.min(df, adj[r.to].get(r.rev).c - adj[r.to].get(r.rev).f);
                u = r.to;
            }
            for (int u = t; u != s; ) {
                Edge r = adj[u].get(par[u]);
                Edge e = adj[r.to].get(r.rev);
                e.f += df;
                r.f -= df;
                price[0] += df * e.p;
                u = r.to;
            }
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                pot[i] = Math.min(INF, dist[i] + pot[i]);
            }
            return df;
        }

        static long minCostFlow(int s, int t, long[] price, int n, boolean sparse) {
            potInit(n);
            long flow = 0;
            price[0] = 0;
            long df;
            while ((df = mcf(s, t, price, n, sparse)) > 0) {
                flow += df;
            }
            return flow;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int m = sc.nextInt();
        int k = sc.nextInt();
        int c = sc.nextInt();
        int d = sc.nextInt();

        final int T = 99;
        final int C = 12;
        final int source = 0;
        final int sink = n * T + 1;
        int nodeCount = sink + 1;
        Flow.init(nodeCount);

        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            int a = sc.nextInt();
            Flow.addEdge(source, a, 1, 0);
        }

        for (int t = 0; t < T; t++) {
            Flow.addEdge(1 + t * n, sink, Flow.INF, 0);
            if (t > 0) {
                for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
                    Flow.addEdge(i + (t - 1) * n, i + t * n, Flow.INF, c);
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            int a = sc.nextInt();
            int b = sc.nextInt();
            for (int j = 0; j < C; j++) {
                long cost = (long)(j + 1) * (j + 1) - (long)j * j;
                for (int t = 1; t < T; t++) {
                    Flow.addEdge(a + (t - 1) * n, b + t * n, 1, cost * d + c);
                    Flow.addEdge(b + (t - 1) * n, a + t * n, 1, cost * d + c);
                }
            }
        }

        long[] price = new long[1];
        long flow = Flow.minCostFlow(source, sink, price, nodeCount, true);
        assert flow == k : "Flow mismatch";
        System.out.println(price[0]);
    }
}
